rules: Never treat missing client, A1, CSC, SEFAZ, prefeitura, bank account, gateway keys or official provider access as an internal development blocker
Continue every independent internal construction task until 100% built and internally certified
Never state external homologation complete based on mocks, unit tests or simulated calls
Never promote commercial release without external certifications applicable to the product and owner approval
Every external blocker must reference a named external configuration or official credential, evidence and responsible party
Every internal blocker must be actionable on code, tests, specification or project architecture
Runtime deployment and external production access remain independently protected by existing AGENTS.md authority
